title: hieracium alatum subsp. rosulifolium
intro: Hieracium alatum subsp. rosulifolium, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating wounds, reducing inflammation, and relieving gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium alatum subsp. rosulifolium include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
